annotations.title: One-off ZUS compensation for an accident at work in Poland (jednorazowe odszkodowanie)

description: Use for the one-off compensation from ZUS for an accident at work or an occupational disease in Poland (jednorazowe odszkodowanie z ZUS): PLN for a percent of health impairment or for the family of a deceased worker, on the date of the ZUS decision. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. One-off compensation from ZUS (jednorazowe odszkodowanie) for an accident at work or an occupational disease in Poland, from the Act on social insurance for accidents at work and occupational diseases (art. 11-15). mode injury: PLN for each percent of permanent or long-term health impairment from the ZUS medical certificate; with previous_percent the increase after a worsening (only when the impairment grew by the statutory number of points); total_incapacity adds the amount for total incapacity to work and to independent living. mode death: compensation for the family of an insured who died in the accident - spouse or child, other family members (parents, step-parents), extra amount per further child, equal split, minus the impairment compensation already paid to the deceased. Amounts are those in force on the date of the ZUS decision (date, default today): the yearly notice of the Minister of Family, Labour and Social Policy in Monitor Polski for the period from 1 April to 31 March, or before the notice the statutory formula from the GUS average wage. Returns the notice used and the history of periods. Not covered: disability pension and civil-law compensation from the employer.

date.description: Date of the ZUS decision, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

mode.description: injury (default) = impairment of the insured; death = family of the deceased.

others.description: death: number of other entitled family members.

paid_to_deceased.description: death: impairment compensation already paid to the deceased, PLN.

total_incapacity.description: injury: total incapacity to work and to independent living certified.
